entries: Roots: the plant holds on and drinks: the roots grow down into the soil, hold the plant in place, and drink up water for the whole plant.
slots.label: Roots
slots.studentPrompt: Explain this step in your own words.

entries: Stem: the plant's lift and road: the stem holds the plant up so the leaves can reach the light, and water travels up the stem from the roots to the leaves.
slots.label: Stem
slots.studentPrompt: Explain this step in your own words.

entries: Leaves: the plant makes its own food: the leaves catch sunlight and use it with water to make food for the plant.
slots.label: Leaves
slots.studentPrompt: Explain this step in your own words.

entries: Watch out: plants do not eat food from the soil: the roots drink water and minerals only - the leaves make the food with sunlight, so the plant does not eat food like we do.
slots.label: A common mistake
slots.studentPrompt: Explain this step in your own words.

entries: The part of the plant that grows down into the soil: the roots hold the plant in place and drink up water and minerals for the whole plant.
slots.label: Roots
slots.studentPrompt: Give your own example of this term.

entries: The part of the plant that holds it up so the leaves can reach the light: it is also a road, carrying water up from the roots to the leaves.
slots.label: Stem
slots.studentPrompt: Give your own example of this term.

entries: The part of the plant that makes its food: the leaves catch sunlight and use it with water to make food for the plant.
slots.label: Leaves
slots.studentPrompt: Give your own example of this term.

entries: Useful substances dissolved in the water in the soil: the roots drink them up with the water, but they are not food for the plant.
slots.label: Minerals
slots.studentPrompt: Give your own example of this term.

entries: All the parts of the plant working together: roots drink, the stem carries and lifts, and the leaves make food, so the whole plant can live and grow.
slots.label: Plant system
slots.studentPrompt: Give your own example of this term.
